selection_policy: A unified library of 24 image assets uses the same verified current/ entry structure. Publish explicitly adopted paths and their current dependencies, independent of version numbers. Unneeded revisions, candidates and video media are excluded from publication. Explicitly retired media are documented by retirement_records; required original, runtime and QA inputs are retained.
historical_metadata_policy: Historical paths/hashes in current catalogs and receipts are provenance, not promises that omitted old files are available in this snapshot.
selection_exclusions_summary: Video containers, unused previous production/source revisions, explicit rejected raw candidates, failed butterfly folded-v002, undersized aircraft attempts and local pre-integration legacy-selection-before snapshot are excluded. A mixed original sheet remains when adopted frames still use its good cells; historical input paths/hashes in current receipts are provenance.
source_asset_update_basis: Selective adopted bow_deep v003 improvement; canonical neutral and17other bear poses reuse unchanged v002 pixels. Frozen18productions and all18other assets are preserved.
